title: Adkins Preparatory School | Home
description: Adkins Preparatory School offers warm, nurturing education in Lower Primary and rigorous, purposeful learning in Upper Primary.

hero.heading: Where children grow in confidence and responsibility
hero.description: Through caring teachers, clear expectations, and purposeful learning, Adkins helps children become respectful, capable, and ready for each next step.

intro.heading: Strong foundations at every stage
intro.text: Lower Primary builds warm relationships, early literacy and numeracy, and a love of learning. Upper Primary develops deeper subject knowledge, independence, responsibility, and readiness for secondary education.
